## Dispatch packet P18
Read initiative videoml-dbc2b1 sections D09 before editing. Those are binding decisions, not suggestions.

## Repositories and edit scope
Babulus
Primary paths: src/worker-lib.ts; service job schema; features/render_claims.feature. Read repository AGENTS before any edits. Do not edit unrelated product code.

## Procedure
1. Read prerequisites and existing implementation at the paths above.
2. Add failing behavioral fixtures for the listed acceptance cases.
3. Add D09 states/tokens/lease/attempt budget with conditional datastore operations; separate pure transition decisions from persistence. Migrate existing state values with explicit migration command, not dual writers. Native Babulus issue required before product edits.
4. Run scoped checks plus required repo quality gates. Save actual commands, exit status and artifacts in an issue comment.
5. Return the diff and evidence to the primary reviewer; do not close the issue yourself.

## Acceptance
race at deadline, stale completion, duplicate cancel, lost heartbeat and max-attempt tests.

## Dependencies
videoml-f708b4 (P17)

## Stop conditions
Do not guess a missing credential/account identity, bypass a failed test, substitute mocked evidence for a real smoke run, expand product scope, or change contract defaults. Report a precise blocker and return to the primary reviewer. A passing build alone is insufficient for rendering behavior.

## Accepted review correction
Implement D09a transition table exactly, including both cancellation orderings, retry exhaustion, cloud reservation no-local-claim invariant and server-side lease time. Test all edges and prohibited edges.
## Required authority/cutover decision
Read initiative D09b. Separate server-owned rendering tables and API in the dedicated account are authoritative; preserve non-render Amplify jobs, disable all legacy render writers, and never attempt cross-account DynamoDB transactions. P18 defines the shared transition/transaction interface before P21/P25 implement it.

## Required authority/cutover decision
Read initiative D09b. Separate server-owned rendering tables and API in the dedicated account are authoritative; preserve non-render Amplify jobs, disable all legacy render writers, and never attempt cross-account DynamoDB transactions. P18 defines the shared transition/transaction interface before P21/P25 implement it.

## Sequencing correction: legacy migration
P18 supplies the read-only operator-export inventory/report and migration transaction/apply contract. The executable apply operation belongs to P22 because it depends on the new authority and the coordinated shutdown of legacy writers. P18 must not translate old unfenced renders into paid jobs or mutate production data. This moves implementation sequencing, not the requirement: P22 and final P28 cannot pass without an explicit reviewed, idempotent migration/cutover command, dry-run report and replay/failure evidence. Read D09c for API admission-time clock and conditional-write semantics; do not promise a DynamoDB commit-time clock.
